# Keep It Simple, Stupid: Explain

## Overview

Use this skill when the user asks a question or wants a concept explained. Keep
the answer clear, brief, and easy to understand.

## Instructions

* Answer the question directly, using a few plain-language sentences by default.
* Prefer familiar words and short sentences. Avoid jargon, fancy wording, and
  filler.
* If a technical term is needed, explain it in simple words the first time.
* Add an example only when it makes the answer easier to understand.
* Include important facts, limits, and safety warnings. Keep them brief and
  explain them plainly.
* Do not leave out details that are needed for an accurate or safe answer.
* Give more detail when the user asks for it or when it is needed to answer
  correctly.
